summary: Phase 1 (admin panel, JWT auth register/login/logout, categories, featured-placement, regression) tested end-to-end. 19/19 backend pytest tests pass. Frontend flows verified: admin login+tabs+filters, logout, protected /studio redirects to /login, creator register lands on /studio, create-tartan with category+target, feature request updates UI to 'Feature pending review', home category chips filter, and Puntland flagship still loads for anonymous users.

issues: React console warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' (twice) rendered on /admin. Likely a duplicate `key` prop in one of the admin lists (Overview by_category or Chains list). Non-blocking but should be fixed to avoid render glitches.

action_items: Fix React duplicate-key warning in /admin (check .map() key props in Admin.jsx, especially by_category rows and chains list).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1450 lines — approaching the 700-line rule-of-thumb split threshold. Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, admin.py, tartans.py, categories.py) for maintainability.
Admin toggle endpoints expect body `{value: bool}` — undocumented; add response models / Pydantic schema so shape is discoverable via OpenAPI.
POST /api/tartans returns an envelope `{tartan, member}` while GET /api/tartans returns a flat list of tartan dicts — inconsistent shapes make client code branchy. Standardize.

In list_tartans the tartan identifier is `token`, but member share links use `share_token`; naming collision is a footgun (my e2e test hit it). Consider renaming member.share_token to member.invite_token.
Studio.jsx re-fetches /my/tartans after every feature request instead of updating local state — fine for now but wasteful.
test_credentials: Admin admin@tartan.app / TartanAdmin2026! works. Test creators/companies registered as TEST_* @tartan.test (see backend fixtures).
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create TEST_creator_*/TEST_company_* users and several TEST-prefixed tartans (Reconnect + Cause) each run. Frontend e2e run also created a couple of TEST_e2e_* creators + TEST Cause/E2E chains. Not automatically cleaned up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend response shapes: POST /api/tartans -> {tartan:{token,...}, member:{share_token,...}}; GET /api/tartans -> [tartan,...] with `token` (not share_token); admin toggles use body {value: bool}; user object uses `role` (admin|creator|company) not `account_type`. Env: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://spread-map.preview.emergentagent.com. Run tests with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_phase1_auth_admin.py -v -o addopts=''` (pytest.ini forces xdist which breaks module-scoped fixtures used here).
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Only a non-blocking React duplicate-key warning on /admin.
